Perfect! I've retrieved the page's current tags. Now let me create 9 optimized suggestions (3 for each of title, meta description, and h1) based on your target keywords: "web design services," "responsive website design," and "freelance web developer."

**Current Issues:**

Your existing title tag "Web Design" is far too short (just 10 characters) and generic. It's missing all three of your target keywords and provides no competitive advantage in search results. The current H1 is good quality but doesn't include any of your primary keywords—it focuses on "custom" and "small businesses" rather than "responsive," "services," or "freelance."

**Key Improvements:**

**Title Tags:** All three suggestions expand the ultra-short current title to include your primary keywords while staying within the optimal 50-60 character range. Each version front-loads different keyword combinations to test what resonates best with your audience—whether you want to emphasize the service offering, your freelance positioning, or the responsive design specialty.

**Meta Descriptions:** Your existing description is solid (mentions responsive websites and targets small businesses) but lacks your specific keywords "web design services," "responsive website design," and "freelance web developer." My suggestions integrate all three target phrases naturally while adding clear calls-to-action like "Get a free quote," "Contact now," and "Start your project" to improve click-through rates.

**H1 Tags:** The current H1 is user-friendly but not optimized for your target keywords. My suggestions incorporate your exact keyword phrases while maintaining readability. Since this is a portfolio page, I've included "Portfolio" in the H1 options to match user intent and page content.

**Additional Note:** Your og:title currently matches your weak title tag ("Web Design") and should be updated alongside it. The missing og:description should also be added to improve social media sharing.

Would you like me to refine any of these, try different keywords, or analyse additional tags (e.g. og:title, canonical URL)?

score.reasoning: The agent delivered all 9 required suggestions with correct tag names and strong keyword integration across all three target phrases. All suggestions comply with technical SEO character limits and read naturally with clear value propositions. The suggestions show good differentiation in angles, though some meta description variations are relatively similar in structure and messaging.
strengths: Excellent keyword integration: all 9 suggestions naturally incorporate the three target keywords (web design services, responsive website design, freelance web developer) in varied combinations
Strong SEO compliance: titles are 47-53 characters (within 50-60 range), H1 tags are natural and readable, and all suggestions maintain high-quality, non-spammy phrasing with clear CTAs

Good differentiation within each tag group: title options emphasize different angles (services-first, freelancer-first, responsive-first), and H1 options vary between portfolio-centric and service-centric approaches
weaknesses: Meta description character counts are slightly off: options 2 and 3 fall below the 150-160 target at 149 and 155 characters respectively, creating minor compliance issues

Limited semantic variety in meta descriptions: all three options follow similar structure (keyword phrase + benefit + CTA) making them feel somewhat repetitive in approach rather than offering distinct positioning angles
